verdict.rationale: AWS's own Free Tier page spells out the new-account credits: $100 immediately plus up to $100 more, for up to $200 over 6 months. It also states there are no charges on the Free plan unless you convert to a Paid plan. That gives the credit limit and the expiry window, which satisfies the story's 'and/or' requirement. missing for 10: per-service always-free tier limits beyond the credit offer, the specific criteria for earning the extra $100, any published startup-program credits, and independent hands-on corroboration that the Free plan produces no charges.

support.subject: As a founder, starting is free — an always-free tier and/or published startup credits with the limits and expiry spelled out

citations.quote: That's up to $200 over 6 months to build, break things, and experiment with no charges and no surprise bills on the Free plan.
When you create a new AWS Free Tier account, you get $100 in credits immediately. As you explore key services, you can earn up to $100 more.
You won't be charged unless you convert to a Paid plan.
